specificFindings: The narrator was surprised that the party house was somewhere in Wisconsin;the next-morning ride back to the YMCA is not confused with the earlier travel. Some vacations focus on meaning,not all vacations or all people.

In the fictional book,Augustine saved the protagonists grandfather in World War II. The story is not presented as a survey. The volunteer examples correctly pair Nepal with womens education,Guatemala with medical volunteerism,and Kenya with wildlife conservation;some students choose Habitat for Humanity.

Friends may be enjoyable,helpful,or broaden horizons;these examples are not mutually exclusive rules. Disneyland is the authors happiness example while Jerusalem and Rome are used for remembering the past and meaning. The New York lyric is attributed to its artists and treated as a song image,not empirical evidence.

Psychological richness is presented as one path,not categorically the best path. Goldmund is a literary example of a possible good life despite low happiness or meaning;the subsequent text allows combinations. Sacks seemed happy at the end of his life is an appropriately qualified author inference,not a measured lifelong clinical score.

The author leaves open possible further good-life dimensions and describes diverse paths. Letterman and Stewart shows and the Top Ten lists are correctly attributed to the authors recollection and preference.

The numbered entries 10 and 9 are structural markers,not full human sentences. Two specifically contextualised questions ask about their role in the authors list. The ninth marker quote is limited to the marker and the displayed inherited parent supplies its heading;no future unassigned sentence is counted as evidence.

The regret entry says people tend to regret actions they could have taken but did not,not that all decisions should always be risky. The stay-or-go question continues in the parent text;its automatically split candidate is not represented as a complete final sentence.

Correct positions and matching translated options/analyses were reordered;several distractors were refined to plausible reversals of timing,relationship and meaning. These adjustments were performed before publication and do not alter old fingerprints.

All 14 full inherited English/Chinese parent pairs and all25 authored questions,translations,analyses,vocabulary and examples reviewed against PDF164-167. Exact evidence passed the planned-ID guard and existing published fingerprints remain locked.

The stay-or-go question is automatically split at quoted punctuation although its main clause continues afterward. The inherited parent preserves the full sentence and English order.
